accounting_period_closed: The accounting period for this date is closed. Choose a date in an open period.
category_automatic_only: This category is only ever booked automatically, never by hand.
vehicle_left_stock: This vehicle has already left stock and cannot be reserved.
vin_already_in_stock: This VIN is already in stock as {{stockNumber}}.
wagenbuch_closed: This vehicle has been sold — its Wagenbuch takes no new entries.
purchase_requires_vin: This vehicle cannot be purchased without its VIN.
purchase_vin_mismatch: This VIN is not the VIN of the vehicle in stock.
configuration_already_linked: A configuration is already assigned to this vehicle. Please reload the page.
configuration_held_by_stock_item: This configuration already belongs to vehicle {{stockNumber}} in stock. Every vehicle has its own configuration.
vehicle_label_follows_configuration: This vehicle's name is its configuration's and follows it. Change the configuration instead.
purchase_already_booked: The purchase of this vehicle is already booked. Cancel it before booking it again.
purchase_not_booked: No purchase is booked for this vehicle, so there is nothing to cancel.
purchase_storno_left_stock: This vehicle has already left stock. Its purchase can no longer be cancelled.
purchase_storno_invoice_requested: The invoice for contract {{contractNumber}} has already been requested. The purchase can no longer be cancelled.
purchase_storno_published: This vehicle is still published on {{channels}}. Unpublish it first, then the purchase can be cancelled.
source_ref_reserved: This reference is reserved for the purchase and its cancellation.
storno_return_not_trade_in: Only a trade-in can go back to its contact.
trade_in_vin_differs: This VIN is not the one the contract holds for the trade-in. If the contract's VIN is wrong, use «Assign configuration» to give the vehicle a configuration with the correct VIN – if it already has one, enter the VIN there with «Edit configuration». The configuration's VIN then applies.
marketplace_connection_disabled: The {{channel}} connection is switched off. {{channel}} still shows the vehicle until the connection is switched on again. Switch it on under Administration › Integrations, then unpublish the vehicle.
vin_correction_left_stock: Not possible: the vehicle has left stock.
vin_correction_needs_vehicle: This vehicle has not been bought yet — its VIN is corrected in the configuration.
vin_unchanged: That is already this vehicle's VIN.
chassis_number_requires_configuration: A vehicle with a chassis number instead of a VIN is bought through its configuration: assign the configuration with the chassis number, make and first registration («Assign configuration»).
